summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Tidyups Cleaning quote landing page. All 9 pytest backend tests pass. All frontend flows (landing render, quote form validation, quote submission, admin login with wrong/right password, leads display, refresh) work end-to-end. Submitted quote persists in DB and appears in admin dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/quotes returns 200 for creation - conventionally 201 Created would be more accurate but not blocking.
Admin auth is a static shared password sent in a header without any rate limiting/lockout; acceptable for MVP but a brute-force protection or a real session/JWT should be added before production.
list_quotes is capped at .to_list(1000) - fine for MVP; add pagination once volume grows.
Backend uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); should migrate to FastAPI lifespan (minor).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_-prefixed quote leads via API/UI (TEST_Jane Doe, TEST_John Full, TEST_UI_User). They remain in DB for main-agent verification if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from frontend/.env is https://expo-book-cleaning.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and are pytest-based. Admin password header is X-Admin-Password. Shadcn Select requires click + 200ms wait + [role=option] click. All flows verified end-to-end and green.
